rows.note: Use this all-purpose verb when you make something moderately wet.

example.english: Be careful not to dampen the blanket.
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 zing2 sap1 zoeng1 pei5

rows.note: Use this when something has become wet by itself or through circumstances, rather than when someone makes it wet.

example.english: It rained all night, causing the clothes to dampen.
example.traditional: 落咗成晚雨，啲衫全部濕咗。
example.jyutping: lok6 zo2 seng4 maan5 jyu6 di1 saam1 cyun4 bou6 sap1 zo2

rows.note: Use this all-purpose construction when an emotion or other abstract quality is made less intense.

example.english: Talking to my friend helped dampen my worries.
example.traditional: 同朋友傾完偈，令我冇咁擔心。
example.jyutping: tung4 pang4 jau5 king1 jyun4 git6 ling6 ngo5 mou5 gam3 daam1 sam1
